name: Team Tasks Full CRUD & Completion Lifecycle
description: Verify team task management directory, new task modal creation, priority filtering, and task completion toggle

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login, sign in as admin@flowcrm.local with password 'FlowAdmin123!', and navigate to /tasks
Verify Task list table loads with task title, due date, priority badge, assignee, and '+ New Task' button
Click '+ New Task' button to open task creation dialog
Fill Title 'Whey Protein 30-Day Re-Order Follow-up', select Priority 'High', and click 'Create Task' or 'Save'
Assert new task appears in the task list with High priority badge
Verify tasks are filtered according to the selected status
Click the checkbox or complete button on a task
Verify the task state updates to Completed
